description: This file defines a SCSS mixin library for Responsive Font Sizes (RFS) with configuration options, functions for calculations, and mixins for applying responsive sizing styles in a stylesheet.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Performs division with precision control, handles units, and prevents division by zero.

methods.name: rfs-value
methods.description: Generates a list of CSS size values with responsive calculations.

methods.name: rfs-fluid-value
methods.description: Calculates smooth, fluid responsive size values between a base and target size.

methods.name: rfs
methods.description: Main mixin that applies responsive font-size or size-related properties with optional media query handling.
